name: NV Live Visitor Count
author: Nitish Verma

sections.description:
NV Live Visitor Count is a simple, fast, and incredibly accurate plugin to track page views on your WordPress site.

Most visitor counters break or stop counting when you use caching plugins. We are different. We use smart AJAX technology to track visitors in the background, ensuring that every single page view is counted instantly, even if your site is fully cached.

🚀 Key Features

  • Seamless WordPress Integration: View your page stats directly inside the native WordPress “Posts” and “Pages” list. A new “Views” column is added automatically!
  • Real-Time Tracking: See page views update instantly as they happen.
  • Cache Compatible: Works 100% with all caching plugins via AJAX.
  • Modern Dashboard: A beautiful, clean admin dashboard showing “Total Lifetime Views”, “Views Today”, and your “Top 10 Most Viewed Pages”.
  • Shortcode Support: Use the [nvlvc_views] shortcode to display the number of views on any post or page for your readers to see.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nv-live-visitor-count directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Check your Posts & Pages list to see the view counts directly.
